symptom: A widget database datasource `where [Name = $currentObject/Mod.Assoc/Name]` passes `mxcli check` and `exec`, then `mx check` reports **CE0161** "Error(s) in XPath constraint." at the widget (combobox, list view, data grid 2, gallery). Reported as the ONE-hop form `[Mod.District_Region = $currentObject/Mod.AreaPicker_Region]` on a combo box
cause: MDL055 (#831) ran only over microflow retrieve constraints; the page side had MDL047 (`= empty`) but no hop-count check, so the two-hop comparand reached mxbuild
insight: **The reported form was valid: measure the issue's own script before writing the rule it asks for.** On fresh 11.13.0 and 11.14.0 projects the one-hop `$currentObject/Mod.Assoc` comparand built at 0 errors in a combobox (`Association:` and `Attribute:` spellings), list view and data grid 2, and is stored verbatim (bson dump), so neither a refusal nor a writer fix was right for it; a rule flagging one hop would refuse valid MDL. The reduced script's only errors were CE0642 "Property 'Caption' is required", one per combo box, because it omits `CaptionAttribute:`. Shapes that DID give CE0161 on 11.14.0 with check passing, one page each in one project: two hops off `$currentObject` (all four list widgets; now MDL055), a one-hop comparand whose target entity differs from the left side's (`[Mod.District_Region = $currentObject/Mod.AreaPicker_District]`), and an UNQUALIFIED association in the comparand (`$currentObject/AreaPicker_Region`). The last two are still unflagged and are candidates for the reporter's real app. Do not measure on testdata/pedapp: its stale widget definitions turn every new combobox into CE0642 Attribute/Values/Caption noise; `mxcli new --theme none --layout none --skip-init --skip-build` gives a 0-error control.
